name: ACM RVCE
description:
What if your college journey could begin with building and shipping products, competing in national hackathons, exploring AI and cybersecurity, publishing top-tier research, and learning directly from people in industry?

That’s what ACM RVCE is all about.

We are a community of passionate developers, designers, researchers, and innovators who love building things that matter. Whether you’re someone who has been coding for years or someone who is just curious about technology, ACM RVCE gives you the space to learn, experiment, and grow.

Our members don’t just attend events: they build projects, participate in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions, work on AI and machine learning initiatives, contribute to open-source, explore research and publications, and collaborate with students across different domains. We regularly organize workshops, technical bootcamps, hackathons, founder talks, and industry sessions that focus on practical learning rather than passive lectures.

Some of our flagship initiatives include TechTank, a national innovation hackathon inspired by real-world problem solving and entrepreneurship; ACM CTF, our cybersecurity competition; Build with GenAI, a hands-on AI hackathon; and industry-focused sessions featuring engineers, founders, researchers, and alumni from leading organizations.

What makes ACM RVCE different is the community. You’ll find people interested in various realms across domains of computers, electrical/electronics and research-oriented learning: all working together, learning from each other, and pushing one another to improve.

As a member, you’ll have opportunities to:

* Build real-world projects
* Explore AI, ML, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies
* Participate in national hackathons and technical competitions
* Learn from industry experts and alumni
* Work on research and publication-oriented initiatives
* Develop leadership, teamwork, and communication skills
* Become part of the global ACM network

Many of our members have gone on to secure internships, win competitions, lead technical initiatives, and contribute to impactful projects. But more importantly, they found a community that helped them grow.

If you’re looking for a place where curiosity turns into skills, ideas turn into projects, and students turn into builders, ACM RVCE is the place to start.

Learn. Build. Compete. Research. Lead.

Your journey starts here.

events.name: Reverse Research Engineering
events.time: Showcase Day BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.venue: BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.detail: An event that gamifies academic writing by challenging teams to decode computer science papers, either inventing an abstract based solely on a descriptive title or engineering a professional title from a redacted abstract. Guided by structural clue sheets and evaluated against the actual published papers, students strip away the intimidation of research while learning how cutting-edge technology is structurally presented.

events.name: ByteStorm – CS Ideathon
events.time: Showcase Day BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.venue: BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.detail: Teams will be given a set of technology-related keywords and must brainstorm an innovative idea around them. Like Shark Tank, participants will pitch their concept to a panel of judges—no coding or prototypes required, just creativity, logic, and a compelling vision.

events.name: Tech-Trap: The Tech-Bluff Tournament
events.time: Showcase Day BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.venue: BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.detail: The event challenges teams to construct a plausible technical paragraph using a given set of terms while intentionally concealing a logical or structural engineering fallacy. Presenting teams attempt to deliver their pitch with absolute confidence, while competing audience members act as rigorous code-reviewers racing to spot the hidden trap and claim the points.

events.name: Tech Time Capsule
events.time: Showcase Day BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.venue: BT Seminar Hall (BioTech Department Seminar Hall)
events.detail: Travel through time by stepping into a randomly assigned era of computing, from the early days of personal computers to a futuristic AI-powered world. Teams must analyze the technological landscape of their timeline and pitch an innovative solution that fits its possibilities and limitations.

name: Alaap
description:
Alaap is the music club of RVCE. Vocalists, instrumentalists, rappers, beatboxers, composers, producers and sound engineers gather here to create music, compete, and entertain self and other. With over 100 members, you will find someone to share your interests in music with, regardless of taste or skill level. There is no single sound that can be ascribed to the club; we are constantly surprising ourselves with experiments across styles of music, and their confluence.

Alaap is an active part of RVCE's cultural calendar. You can find us performing at the college's flagship events: E-Summit and 8th Mile, as well as other significant occasions such as Kannada Habba, Matrubhasha Divas, Kannada Rajyotsava , etc. We have also performed at events such as the IEEE conference held in IIIT Bangalore, and for your enjoyment during the SIP (28th August @ Civil Seminar Hall - don't miss out, we have some fun stuff planned). 

Competition is a core aspect of Alaap's culture. Participation in individual and band competitions across the country - and winning -  is a monthly occurrence. We also host Clash of Chords, a battle of bands for college bands across Bengaluru during 8th Mile.

We are always learning and teaching about music. Masterclasses, album listening sessions, internal competitions and open mics are staples in the club calendar.

If you play, sing, write, produce, or simply enjoy being around people who care about music, come find us at the SIP or an open mic. We look forward to seeing you at auditions later this year.

description: Ashwa Racing, India’s first Formula Student team, has been driving innovation since 2003. From building its first prototype in 2005 to competing at FSAE Australasia, FS Germany, and FS Italy, the team has proudly represented India on the global stage. In 2015, Ashwa ventured into hybrid technology, earning a world top-10 rank in its very first attempt. name: Coding Club RVCE
description: The Coding Club at RVCE is a student led coding community focused on bridging the gap between academic theory and practical industry skills. Through hands-on workshops, hackathons, and collaborative projects, the club provides a space for students to build real-world engineering solutions.

events.name: The Human Neural Network
events.detail: Turn 70 students into a living neural network and experience how information flows through layers to make predictions. Watch the network learn from its mistakes through forward propagation, backpropagation, and weight updates—without writing a single line of code.

events.name: Black Box Bazaar
events.detail: Decode hidden functions from input-output clues, then buy, sell, trade, or bluff your way to the top. A fast-paced marketplace that turns pattern recognition, algorithmic thinking, and strategy into a competitive game.

events.name: Lethal Dose of Tokens (CTF)
events.detail: Capture the Flag Event - Players infiltrate a deliberately vulnerable code repository, uncovering hidden secrets by exploiting prompt injection and poor security practices. Navigate the repo, manipulate the AI, and extract what you're not supposed to see in this AI-powered cybersecurity challenge.

events.name: The Predictive Engine
events.detail: Transform 70+ students into an ensemble learning system that analyzes clues, makes confidence-weighted predictions, and learns from every mistake. Teams compete to build the most accurate predictive model while experiencing ensemble learning, adaptive weighting, and real-time model updates.

name: Debate Society
description:
The RVCE Debate Society (DebSoc) is more than just a debating society, it's a place where ideas are challenged, confidence is built and lifelong friendships are made. Whether you've never debated before or have years of experience, there's a place for you here. We believe that every voice deserves to be heard and we're here to help you find yours.

Through weekly practice sessions, workshops, events and tournaments across the nation and internationally, you'll learn to think critically, speak confidently and tackle ideas from every perspective. DebSoc isn't just about winning debates. It's about growing as a communicator, being an active listener and learning how to think on your feet.

From late-night prep sessions and tournament trips to unforgettable memories with teammates, RV DebSoc offers an experience that goes far beyond the podium. If you're looking for a community that challenges you, supports you, and pushes you to become the best version of yourself, you've just found it. We can't wait to welcome and hear what you have to say!

events.name: The Great Debatsby
events.detail: A fiery 2v2 British Parliamentary debate with sharp speeches, rebuttals and a flow that spans politics, ethics, science and culture.

events.name: Catch Me If You Can
events.detail: A 4 player mystery debate where one player does not know the motion.  They must figure out the motion with context clues before they get voted out.

events.name: Knives Out
events.detail: Judges take a hard stance on real-world issues, and it’s on you to argue, persuade and flip their position.

events.name: Devil’s Advocate
events.detail: Given a motion and stance, you prep fast, dive in, and survive the chaos, adaptability wins the day.

name: Ecell
description:
Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell)

The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) is a student-driven institutional platform committed to cultivating a culture of innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership, and experiential learning among students. The Cell provides a structured ecosystem that encourages young innovators and aspiring entrepreneurs to transform ideas into impactful initiatives while developing the skills required to navigate real-world challenges.

E-Cell functions through five specialized verticals—Corporate Partnerships, Events & Operations, Department of Startup & Innovation, Media & Tech, and Marketing & Public Relations. Each vertical plays a strategic role in advancing the Cell’s objectives while offering students opportunities to gain practical exposure through workshops, industry interactions, project-based learning, and collaborative initiatives.

Through a diverse portfolio of entrepreneurial workshops, business competitions, techno-cultural events, industry interactions, and entrepreneur talks, E-Cell bridges the gap between academic learning and professional practice. These initiatives enable students to develop competencies in areas such as business strategy, market analysis, communication, leadership, networking, marketing, and problem-solving, thereby fostering an entrepreneurial mindset across the campus.

Key Milestones and Flagship Initiatives

8th Mile – The Flagship Fest of RVCE
E-Cell plays a significant role in the successful execution of 8th Mile, RVCE’s annual techno-cultural fest that brings together students and clubs across the institution. The Cell contributes extensively to sponsorship acquisition, corporate outreach, funding, marketing, and event operations, supporting the fest’s scale, visibility, and overall impact.

E-Summit – A Premier Entrepreneurial Platform
E-Summit is one of Bengaluru’s prominent collegiate entrepreneurial fests, attracting 10,000+ participants and attendees. The event integrates cultural vibrancy with techno-entrepreneurial competitions, providing students with a platform to showcase innovative ideas, engage in business challenges, interact with industry professionals, and develop entrepreneurial acumen.

Hult Prize – Fostering Global Impact
E-Cell facilitates the campus-level Hult Prize, a globally recognised platform that challenges students to develop innovative and sustainable solutions to pressing social and environmental challenges. Participants pitch their ideas before experienced entrepreneurs and distinguished judges. The winning team receives a cash prize and the opportunity to progress towards the global Hult Prize Summit in Dubai, providing a pathway to international exposure and impact.

Exuberance & Embark – Experiential Business Challenges
Exuberance and Embark are flagship business-oriented initiatives designed to provide participants with hands-on exposure to real-world entrepreneurial scenarios. Through activities involving product pitching, market analysis, strategic decision-making, business planning, and growth strategies, these events enable students to understand the complexities of building, managing, and sustaining a venture.

Through its sustained initiatives and flagship programmes, E-Cell contributes to the development of a dynamic entrepreneurial ecosystem at RVCE, empowering students to innovate, collaborate, assume leadership, and translate ideas into meaningful solutions with real-world relevance.

name: EVOKE
description:
Evoke is the official fashion club of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), providing a dynamic platform for students to explore and express their creativity through fashion, modelling, styling, and visual arts.

The club brings together students with different talents and gives them opportunities to showcase their creativity, build confidence, and represent RVCE at various college events and competitions.

*Fashion Shows & Modelling – Organising and participating in fashion shows, ramp walks, and inter-college competitions.
* 🎨 Styling & Design – Creating concepts, themes, outfits, makeup, props, and overall visual aesthetics for performances.
* 📸 Content & Social Media – Creating promotional content, photoshoots, reels, posters, and managing the club’s digital presence.
* 🎭 Event Performances – Representing RVCE at fests, cultural events, club showcases, and competitions.
 *  🏆 Competitions – Participating in inter-collegiate fashion events and bringing recognition to RVCE.

Beyond modelling and fashion, Evoke encompasses a wide range of creative and organisational activities, including styling and costume design, makeup and grooming, choreography, photography, videography, content creation, social media, event planning, and production. Members work collaboratively to conceptualise themes, develop visual narratives, coordinate performances, and execute events from conception to completion.

name: HAM Club
description:
Inaugurated on August 27, 2019, under the Department of ECE, we are a student-led community built for amateur radio enthusiasts who love getting hands-on with wireless communication. Whether you want to master Morse code, build custom antennas, or learn about radio electronics, we offer the tools, mentoring, and workshops to help you level up your tech skills.

Here is a glimpse of what we do:

1.Get Licensed: We guide you through the Amateur Station Operator's Certificate (ASOC) exam governed by the Ministry of Communications, Govt. of India, with mentoring sessions covering radio regulations, basic radio electronics, and atmospheric propagation.

2.Hands-on Workshops: Dive into practical builds and advanced electronics, from Antenna Design and Software Defined Radio (SDR + MATLAB) to Phase Locked Loop (PLL) circuits and Attenuator Building.

3.Exciting Radio Events: Test your direction-finding techniques in Fox Hunting events to track down hidden transmitters, decode secret Morse signals, and construct custom antennas like the MOXON and Yagi-Uda.

name: IEEE RVCE
description:
Established in 2017 with the support of the IEEE Bangalore Section. The IEEE RVCE Student Branch has grown from a small group of passionate students to a thriving community of over 250 members. Over the years, we have consistently fostered technical excellence, innovation, and professional development through a wide range of high-quality events and initiatives.
From organising workshops, seminars, and technical talks to seamlessly transitioning to webinars and virtual learning experiences during the pandemic, we have remained committed to our belief that learning should never stop. At IEEE RVCE, we encourage students to explore research, work on impactful projects, and develop practical skills that extend beyond the classroom. Through our activities, leadership opportunities, and collaborative environment, we strive to empower members to become skilled engineers, innovative thinkers, and future technology leaders.
The student Chapter of RVCE currently comprises of the following Societies and Affinity Groups:

Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society [GRSS]

name: NSS RVCE
description:
The National Service Scheme (NSS) is a public service programme sponsored by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, established with the aim of developing the personality and character of student volunteers through community service. Launched in 1969, NSS remains one of India's largest and longest-running student volunteer programmes, active across colleges and universities nationwide.

The NSS unit at RV College of Engineering (RVCE) operates under this national framework, guided by the motto "Not Me, But You," and provides students with a structured platform to engage in social welfare and community development activities alongside their academic pursuits. NSS RVCE volunteers participate in both Regular Activities, conducted through the academic year, and Special Camps, typically held annually in rural or underserved areas with support from the Government of India. Reported areas of engagement for the unit include village outreach and camp-based service, environmental initiatives such as tree plantation and cleanliness drives, and social awareness campaigns on themes such as health, hygiene, and civic responsibility. These activities are designed to give volunteers direct exposure to community needs while building a habit of consistent, documented social service.

In keeping with the broader objectives of the National Service Scheme, NSS RVCE volunteers work on themes spanning literacy and education support, public health awareness, environmental conservation, and disaster preparedness, depending on the specific activity or camp. Volunteers typically log service hours toward the scheme's Regular Activity and Special Camp requirements, with active participation opening pathways to state- and national-level NSS recognition, including national integration camps and youth leadership programmes coordinated by the scheme at the state and central government levels.

Membership is open to students across departments and years of study, with no prior volunteering experience required. Volunteers are typically guided by faculty programme officers who coordinate activity planning, camp logistics, and liaison with local government bodies and community partners, ensuring that the unit's initiatives are properly organized and aligned with NSS guidelines at the state level.

As with NSS units nationally, participation is intended to build empathy, social responsibility, and leadership qualities in volunteers while contributing tangible service to the communities RVCE engages with. For students looking to complement their engineering education with a structured, service-oriented experience, NSS RVCE offers a long-established and officially recognized way to do so.

name: Quizcorp
description: RV QuizCorp is the official quizzing club of RV College of Engineering, dedicated to fostering curiosity, knowledge and intellectual engagement.As a club, we are dedicated to mentoring new quizzers, fostering a love for lifelong learning and creating an environment where every question leads to a new discovery and a fun time for the members. Our vision is to make quizzing not just a competition but something people would love to participate in as a hobby.

events.name: India Quiz
events.detail: A quiz on the rich culture, history and heritage of our nation.

events.name: Literature and Entertainment Quiz
events.detail: A quiz on movies, music, literature and the world of entertainment.

events.name: Sports Quiz
events.detail: A quiz on quite literally every sport on earth.

events.name: Science Business Technology Quiz
events.detail: A quiz on the world of science, business and technology

name: RAAG
description: Welcome to RAAG! We are a dynamic community of students passionate about our field. Join us to explore, learn, and grow through our various activities and projects.

events.name: Ice Breaker Games- Laugh. Connect.
events.detail: Repeat. Kick things off with laughter and chaos! Fun, quirky games to help you vibe with your batchmates and make instant connections—no awkward intros, just pure fun. . RAAG, the youth club of RVCE, adds energy and creativity to campus life. Through its five verticals and events like 8th Mile, Matrubhasha Divas, and Night Cricket, it fosters leadership, collaboration, and the true spirit of youth. It is a platform for students to explore talents, innovate, and create unforgettable experiences. With unity and diversity at its core, RAAG truly reflects the vibrant spirit of RVCE. We Create Culture, We Redefine Youth, We Make A Difference!

name: ROTARACT CLUB OF R.V.C.E.
description:
The Rotaract Club of RVCE is a student-led community focused on Service, Leadership, and Fellowship. Through the club, students get opportunities to engage with the community, take up responsibilities, and explore interests outside academics in a supportive and energetic environment.

From Project Pusthaka, blood donation drives, and social initiatives to sports tournaments, cultural events, workshops, fundraisers, and inter-college collaborations, there is always something happening. You could be planning an event, designing its publicity, managing registrations, coordinating with people, or simply being part of the team that makes it happen. Every event brings a different experience and a chance to try something you haven't done before.

And you don't have to walk in with experience or a long list of achievements. Just come with an open mind and the willingness to get involved. Meet new people, try new things, find your place, and make your years at RVCE memorable. Rotaract might just be the decision you didn't know you needed to make.

events.name: Meet, Mingle and Guess
events.detail: An interactive icebreaker where participants receive a mystery word and interact with others to identify it. They can converse with one person only for 30 seconds with Yes/No/Maybe questions only, encouraging them to meet more people. With Rotaract-themed words included, the activity introduces freshers to the club’s values of communication, networking, teamwork, and leadership.

events.name: Agent X - Rotaract Edition
events.detail: A strategy-based social deduction game where teams work together to complete a common mission while one hidden Traitor secretly tries to mislead them. Participants must observe behaviour, communicate, discuss, and identify the Traitor through voting. The game promotes teamwork, critical thinking, leadership, trust, and effective communication in an engaging setting.

events.name: Task Card Chaos - Complete, Connect & Conquer
events.detail: A high-energy interactive activity where participants draw random task cards featuring fun challenges, icebreakers, mini-games, and creative missions. Participants earn points by completing as many tasks as possible within the given time. The activity encourages confidence, creativity, communication, and networking while giving freshers an engaging introduction to Rotaract.

events.name: Rotaract Unplugged
events.detail: Curious about Rotaract? Wondering what the club is all about, what you can learn, and where you can make a difference? Join us for an open Q&A session where you can ask questions, hear real experiences, and get a closer look at life in Rotaract.

name: RVCE Women in Cloud Insider Circle
description: First of its kind socio-technical team at RVCE which emerged as student chapter of Women in Cloud centre of excellence,India. The mission of the Women in Cloud Insider Circle is to create a vibrant community that empowers women in cloud computing and technology through mentorship, education, and networking opportunities.By fostering inclusivity, collaboration, and professional growth, we aim to shape a future where women are integral to the evolution of the tech industry and society in overall.

events.name: Networking Nexus
events.detail: An interactive session on building a strong professional network, with a focus on effective LinkedIn profiles, personal branding, meaningful connections, and leveraging LinkedIn for career and internship opportunities.

events.name: Introduction to Cloud and Internships
events.detail: An introductory session on cloud computing, its industry applications, and how students can explore internship opportunities in the cloud domain.

events.name: Vision 2030- From Freshman to Final Year
events.detail: A guidance session helping students plan their academic and professional journey from freshman year to final year, with a focus on skills, opportunities, and career growth.

events.name: From Pen to Publish
events.detail: A session introducing students to the research and publication process, covering how to develop ideas, write research papers, and successfully publish them.

name: Sattva
description:
"Every artist was first an amateur." — Ralph Waldo Emerson

That's exactly what our art club is built on. It's not just a place to make art, it's a place to figure yourself out while doing it. We're split into two sides, visual arts and liberal arts, but honestly the lines blur all the time because that's the whole point: everyone's welcome to try a bit of everything. What we love most is the people. We've got some seriously talented folks in here, but more than that, we've built a safe, creative space where people actually open up through poems, through conversations, through just sitting together and creating something. It shows up in our group chats and in quiet moments at the park just as much as it does in our art. If you're someone who wants to create, explore who you are a little more, and be around people who get it, come find us. We'd love to have you.
CREATED TO CREATE!

events.detail: Instead of having people pass a long expression, we let them pass a picture via each person drawing.

events.detail: We have a standard template that everyone fills it with their own unique elements

events.name: Back where we started
events.detail: Write a pice or story or poem where the first and last lines are the same

events.name: Dream Author
events.detail: Write the summary of your dream novel or book if you were a famous author

name: SPARK : The IUCEE Student Chapter
description: SPARK : IUCEE RVCE Student Chapter at RVCE promotes project-based learning, innovation, research, leadership, and industry exposure. Industrial Connect is a key vertical, giving students first-hand exposure through visits to Indian Coach Factory (ICF), Infosys Mysore, Kaiga Nuclear Power Plant, and U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru, along with interactions with industry professionals and real-world engineering practices. Activities & Events include workshops, hackathons like Edu-AI-thon, and competitions. Projects & Research focuses on innovation, prototyping, and technical projects. Women Empowerment drives initiatives like Shakti Shiksha. Social Media & Podcast connects students through the Insight Podcast, creating opportunities to learn, network, lead, and grow.

events.name: Mission: Impossible? – Build. Adapt. Pitch.
events.detail: A 2-hour innovation challenge where teams are given a set of random problems, technologies, and constraints and must turn them into a workable startup idea. Starting with ideation, teams progressively build their solution using assigned components, adapt when unexpected twists arise, and navigate an ethical dilemma. The challenge culminates in a creative startup pitch, where teams showcase their solution, reasoning, adaptability, and teamwork.

events.name: Digital Launchpad Masterclass: LinkedIn, College Email Benefits & Leveraging AI
events.detail: Build a professional LinkedIn profile, unlock exclusive software and learning benefits through your college email ID, and learn to leverage AI tools for research, productivity, and academic workflows. This hands-on session equips you with practical skills to enhance your digital presence and work smarter throughout your college journey.

events.name: Stations of an Innovator
events.detail: Step into the journey of an innovator through five interactive stations, moving from problem-solving to impact. Begin by identifying real-world problems and turning them into creative ideas at Idea Ignition, then bring those ideas to life through hands-on building at Prototype Playground. Take your solution to the Pitch Arena, where you communicate its value and impact. Reflect and imagine future possibilities at the Impact Wall, before discovering SPARK’s projects, achievements, and opportunities at the Club Showcase.

events.name: Decode.exe
events.detail: Enter a room of interconnected decoding stations where every solved clue reveals a number leading closer to the final answer. Teams begin by uncovering anomalies in the Death Registry Puzzle, then progress through Mystery.exe, decoding ciphers, operations, and binary sequences. A final astronomy or technology-based challenge completes the trail. Combining logic, aptitude, observation, and teamwork, the first team to crack every clue wins.

name: Team Antariksh
description: Team Antariksh is a student space technology club dedicated to advancing innovation in aerospace engineering. The team designs and builds CanSats and experimental sounding rockets, combining innovation with technical expertise. Each project shows commitment to inspire students to challenge boundaries and invoke curiosity in the field of space technology.

events.name: Team Antariksh Orientation
events.detail: Introduction to our club activities and roadmap for the year.

name: Team Astra Robotics
description: Astra Robotics is the interdisciplinary robotics club of RVCE — a team of thinkers, builders, and dreamers who use robotics to solve real-world problems, one smart solution at a time. The club works across domains like embedded systems, ROS2, computer vision, IoT, and machine learning, and has built notable projects such as Tara (a Mars Rover prototype competing internationally in the Rover Challenge Series across the USA, Poland, Turkey, and India), ARES (an autonomous recon and elimination system with target tracking capability), and Doggo (a quadruped robot for R&D in locomotion and control systems). Astra Robotics has earned recognition including 1st Place at IIT Bombay's E-Yantra Innovation Award (2024), 2nd Runner-up at the Indian Rover Design Challenge (2023), and PDRA qualification at the University Rover Challenge (2024).

events.name: ROS2 Intro and Rover Simulation on RViz
events.detail: Get to learn ROS2, the backbone of modern robotics, by visualizing a rover's sensors, movement, and navigation in RViz. See how real robots "think" and move, right from your screen.

events.name: Gazebo Simulations: ARES, HAL and Mbot
events.detail: Step into realistic robot simulations powered by Gazebo's physics engine. Drive and navigate our very own bots — HAL, Mbot, and ARES — autonomously through simulated environments and experience robotics come to life.

events.name: TinkerCAD
events.detail: Design and simulate Arduino-based electronic circuits virtually before bringing them to life in hardware. A perfect first step into the world of embedded systems and electronics.

events.name: Robotic Arm Challenge
events.detail: Take control of a robotic arm and put your precision to the test in an exciting pick-and-place challenge. Program it, move it, and master the art of robotic manipulation.

name: Team Chimera
description:
Established in 2006, Team Chimera is the official electric racing team of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), Bengaluru. Over the years, the team has evolved from developing hybrid powertrains to engineering high-performance electric race cars that embody the principles of sustainable mobility and innovation. With a strong focus on design, simulation, testing, and manufacturing, Team Chimera develops custom-built vehicles and competes at national and international Formula Student events.

Rooted in RVCE’s legacy of engineering excellence, the team continues to push the boundaries of electric vehicle technology, performance, and sustainable transportation. Building on its achievements, Team Chimera participated in Formula Bharat 2026, held in Coimbatore in January 2026, and has already begun rigorous preparations for Formula Bharat 2027. As a testament to the team’s consistent performance and competitive standing, Team Chimera currently ranks 2nd among 45 teams, reflecting its strong technical capabilities and commitment to excellence.

name: Team dhRuVa
description: dhRuVa is the astrophysics club at RV College of Engineering. What began as a quest to explore the secrets of the universe is now a growing team of amateur astrophysics enthusiasts. We at dhRuVa host stargazing events, astrophysics-related coding competitions and engage in discussions on latest observations made by the astrophysics community all over the globe. We share our understanding through informative videos, blogs and journals. We constantly try to keep up with the happenings of the universe through telescopes, radio telescopes and analysis. Join us on our journey to unravel the stars.

name: Team Elektra
description: Team Elektra is the official Mobility Club of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), focused on autonomous systems, electric mobility, emerging technologies and intelligent transportation. The club works on research and industry-driven projects, including WIRIN, India's first indigenous autonomous vehicle, along with EV simulation, wireless power transfer, battery management, software-defined vehicles, autonomous agriculture, and EV retrofitting. Through multidisciplinary collaboration, Team Elektra equips students with practical skills in next-generation mobility technologies.

events.detail: Explore our club's innovative projects, prototypes, and technical achievements.

events.name: ElectriQuiz
events.detail: A quick and interactive quiz that explores the world of electric vehicles, renewable energy, and sustainable transportation.

events.name: Circuit Challenge
events.detail: Solve simple circuit puzzles by connecting components correctly before the timer runs out.

events.name: Mobility Innovators
events.detail: Receive a real-world transportation problem and work in teams to design the most practical and creative solution within a limited time.

name: Team Helios Racing
description:
Founded in 2006 at RV College of Engineering,
Bengaluru, Team Helios Racing is built on over 18 years of relentless engineering excellence, having designed and fabricated 12+ high-performance ATVs and earned top honours on both national and international stages.
After making the bold transition from mBAJA to
eBAJA in 2023, we now stand at the threshold of our fourth season in electric racing. Backed by
experience, driven by innovation, and united by an unyielding will to win, we are here with a single purpose: not merely to compete, but to set the benchmark and lead the charge.

events.name: Meet the Machine
events.detail: Before anything else, come see what we actually build. This session is a walkthrough of Team Helios Racing and GT27, our current eBAJA vehicle - the systems that go into it, the subsystems the team is divided into, and what it actually takes to get a car onto the track. Consider it your first look under the hood of the club: no jargon overload, just a straight introduction to who we are, what we're building, and where you'd fit in.

events.name: The Helios Trails
events.detail: This activity is a fast-paced, Squid Game-inspired engineering relay race where teams of 5 to 6 compete to solve four technical challenges in the shortest time. To build teamwork and strategy, members must navigate the course in the shortest time possible and strategically delegate exactly one specialist to tackle each puzzle.

events.name: Assembly Line
events.detail: This high-speed, pit-crew style challenge tests teamwork, precision, and technical efficiency as teams split up to race against the clock. While one half of the team races to mount and secure the tires onto the chassis, the other half takes on the intricate task of assembling the gearbox. The team that demonstrates the best coordination and clocks the absolute fastest combined assembly time takes the win

events.name: Baja Beyond Borders
events.detail: Teams are given a random challenge card with a unique environment or mission. They have 2–3 minutes to brainstorm how they would redesign the Helios Baja car to survive that scenario. Afterward, each team gives a 1-minute pitch explaining their design.

name: Team Krushi
description: Team KRUSHI is the multidisciplinary agricultural innovation team of RV College of Engineering (RVCE). We bring together students from diverse engineering branches to develop practical, affordable, and sustainable solutions for real-world farming challenges. Through research, design, prototyping, IoT, AI, robotics, and field testing, members gain hands-on technical experience while creating meaningful social impact. Join us to innovate, collaborate, learn from experts, and transform ideas into technologies that empower farmers and promote sustainable agriculture.

events.name: Krushi Kickstart  :  (Ideathon)
events.detail: What if your random idea could solve a real farming problem? Step into a fast-paced challenge where you'll brainstorm, build, and pitch innovative solutions—even if you've never done it before. No experience needed, just curiosity!

events.name: Tractor Unlocked (Tractor Workshop)
events.detail: Ever wondered what's hidden beneath the hood of a tractor? Get hands-on with the machine that powers agriculture and discover how engineering meets farming in the real world.

events.name: Pitch. Build. Disrupt. (Agri Startup Pitch)
events.detail: Imagine you're the founder of the next big agritech startup. Can you convince investors in just a few minutes? Turn bold ideas into business pitches and experience the startup world firsthand.

name: TEDxRVCE
description: TEDxRVCE is RVCE's independently organized TED event. We bring in cool speakers, fresh ideas, and unforgettable moments, bringing together changemakers, storytellers, and innovators to share ideas worth spreading. Our events are planned and executed entirely by a student team, recreating the global TED experience on campus, amplifying diverse voices, creativity, and meaningful connections.

events.name: Color Fusion Challenge (or) Hue & Create
events.detail: This activity combines colour accuracy with creative thinking. Participants must first recreate randomly generated target colours using a digital colour picker. The colours they successfully match become the only colours they can use to complete a creative circle illustration challenge.

events.name: Ad-Absurdum
events.detail: Students will be made into teams of 2–3, and they will be asked to sell an unsellable product (for example, a broken umbrella or an empty pen). Once that’s done, the teams will be asked to make a reel on their product as an advertisement.

events.name: Headline & Emoji Challenge
events.detail: Participants guess a movie from emojis displayed on a laptop and then create a creative newspaper headline for it. The activity encourages teamwork and creativity, requiring only a laptop, paper, and pens.

events.name: Pictogram Puzzle & Guess the Imposter
events.detail: Participants are given images representing themes of previous TEDx events and asked to guess them in a fun Pictionary-style game. Following that, in “Guess the Imposter,” participants are shown titles or headlines of absurd TED talks, with one being fake, and must identify the imposter.
